second_method.method: printed BLUE PRINT difficulty table total (Easy 9 + Average 8 + Difficulty 7 = 24), pdf 60; independently, the answer side's keys counted

count_gate.note: Question side labels 1-24 monotonic, no gaps, no duplicates. BLUE PRINT 9/8/7 = 24 = audited count. Answer side prints keys 1-15: 1-3 match by number; 4-15 belong to another version of the questions. Difficulty per question: easy 0, average 0, difficult 0, untagged 24.

method_notes: Pages: Q pdf 60 (heading, LO 6, BLUE PRINT, q1-3) 61 (q4-15) 62 (q16-24 A) 63 (q24 B-E). A side 'Key Answers: 15' pdf 116 (keys 1-14), pdf 117 top (15). Folios = pdf page.

KEY SIDE: q1-q3 keyed by printed letter (A Cricket, D 6 run, A Postman). q4-q24 empty + 'key belongs to another paper version' with content pointers q7 <- 6, q18 <- 8, q19 <- 5, q20 <- 9 (partial), q24 <- 11-15; q21-q23 'no answer printed'. Section II says 'choosing appropriate word from the bracket' but prints no bracket (noted).

Sections: s1 I mcq q1-3; s2 II fill q4-7; s3 III T/F q8-11 (answer brackets removed from text); s4 IV match q12-15 (numbered rows -> one-pair match questions); s5 V q16-19; s6 VI q20; s7 q21 letter; s8 q22 draw; s9 q23; s10 VII q24 pictures A-E (stimulus, 5 crops).
MARKS (R-E9, rev 3): s1-s5 1; null where N disagrees: s6 '2X1=2' over 1 q, s7-s9 '4*1=4' over 1 q each, s10 '5X1=5' over 1 q.

DIFFICULTY: none printed -> null + 'no difficulty tag'. quota_table difficulty_only; second method = BLUE PRINT total 24 (agrees). LO (R-E10): the lesson's LO row prints LO 6 with the text 'Identifies the need for public amenities and protect them.' (stored as printed; differs from LO 6 in the LO list).
PARKED (R-E8; T-E1): empty true/false q8-q11 and match q12-q15 cannot pass gate 2.20. Built in the work dir with its crops; not committed.
